name: Runway
hook: Dress for the theme. Own the runway.
how: A theme is announced, then you have 90 seconds in the dressing room to pick hair, top, bottoms, shoes, an extra and colors. Every model walks the runway and strikes a pose while everyone else rates the look 1 to 5 stars. Best average takes the podium.
controls: Tap or click pieces and colors to dress, drag to turn your model, tap stars (or keys 1–5) to rate
uses: One player's browser announces the theme, runs the walks and adds up the stars; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot models dress for the theme, walk and rate the others until enough people join.
Everyone sees the same model on the runway, in the outfit its owner picked.
